data.title: 厄普西隆 · 皇家剧院的月光夜奏曲
data.description: 宏伟华丽的王立大剧院舞台正中，束光灯倾泻在漆黑的施坦威三角钢琴上。厄普西隆闭目全情弹奏《月光》，紫发与深蓝长裙随琴音激昂飘拂。
data.location: grand opera concert hall stage before an empty darkened audience auditorium
data.action: playing grand piano with passionate virtuosic posture, arched back, delicate fingers dancing on black and white keys, eyes closed in musical ecstasy
data.lighting: 舞台聚光灯束与冷调剧场轮廓光
data.promptProse: Epsilon plays a concert grand piano beneath a dramatic stage spotlight in an empty theater, fingers flying across keys as her gown cascades around the bench.
data.animaCaption: A solitary beam of light tracks her flying fingers over the gleaming grand piano.
